# otel-gui

> Local-first OpenTelemetry viewer for traces, logs, and metrics. Its HTTP API
> can be used by scripts and agents; MCP is also available for compatible agents.

## Documentation

- [HTTP API guide](https://github.com/metafab/otel-gui/blob/main/docs/http-api.md): endpoint behavior, examples, limits, and access considerations.
- [OpenAPI specification](./openapi.yaml): machine-readable description of the `/api/*` HTTP routes, served with this instance.
- [README](https://github.com/metafab/otel-gui/blob/main/README.md): setup, OTLP ingestion, MCP configuration, and project overview.

## Notes

- The `/api/*` routes are unversioned application endpoints, not a compatibility-guaranteed public API.
- The HTTP API has no authentication. Protect deployments at the network boundary.
- `/v1/traces`, `/v1/logs`, and `/v1/metrics` are OTLP ingestion endpoints, not read APIs.
